name: Tresemme Keratin Smooth Anti-Frizz Hair Serum 50ml with Argan Oil, for 2X Smoother Hair and Long Lasting Frizz control upto 48H even in 80% humidity
description:
Product details of Tresemme Keratin Smooth Anti-Frizz Hair Serum – 50ml (with Argan & Camellia Oil)

Product Type: Anti-Frizz Hair Serum

Size: 50ml

Key Ingredients: Keratin Protein, Argan Oil & Camellia Oil

Suitable For: All hair types (natural & chemically treated)

Key Features:

Provides 2X smoother hair with up to 48 hours frizz control, even in 80% humidity

Enriched with Keratin protein to tackle dryness, reduce damage, and strengthen hair

Camellia oil nourishes, tames frizz, adds vibrancy, and enhances shine

Helps control split ends and makes unruly hair more manageable

Lightweight, professional-quality formula for a salon-smooth finish

Protects, nourishes, and improves overall hair quality
